question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the idiom given in bold in the following sentence.**

At supper, everyone was **__in high spirits__. **
solution:
The correct answer is **'cheerful'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In high spirits **is an **idiom** that means **'very happy and excited' (**बहुत खुश और उत्साहित**).**

 
 
• ***Example*** - *All the children were **in high spirits** (*उच्च उमंग के साथ *) on the last day of school.*
 
 
 
• So, **cheerful **is the most appropriate meaning of the idiom given in bold in the following sentence.
 
• Hence, **option 1 **is the correct answer.
